newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ 91-day T-bills yield 6.875 pct at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ 91-day T-bills yield 6.875 pct at tender.

text.p: The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 91-day treasury bills at Tuesday's tender was 6.875 percent versus 6.677 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender, the Reserve Bank said.
The weighted average yield for NZ$75 million of 182-day treasury bills was 6.857 percent versus 6.713 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
The weighted average yield for the NZ$50 million of 371-day treasury bills was 7.078 percent versus 7.007 percent for a similar maturity at last week's tender.
